blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Former President Rodrigo Duterte finally appeared in person before the International Criminal Court (ICC) Trial Chamber III on Wednesday during the third status conference in his crimes against humanity case. Wednesday’s proceedings marked the first time Duterte personally appeared before the tribunal since he was arrested in March 2025. Dressed in a dark suit and white shirt with no tie, the former president sat with his chin resting on his hands as the proceedings opened.
